verdict.rationale: Qodo documents first-party plugins for Claude Code and Codex that let those agents retrieve and resolve Qodo review findings. An MCP server also exposes 'retrieve and resolve review findings' to any agent, which meets the story's direct-integration path. missing for 10: a named Cursor-specific integration (only generic MCP is documented), any copyable per-finding fix prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the handoff working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, review findings hand off cleanly to my coding agent — copyable fix prompts or direct integration with Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex

citations.quote: Use Qodo with Claude to access Qodo Agentic Toolbox skills for understanding your codebase, reviewing changes, and resolving code review findings.
Use the Qodo plugin with the Codex agent to access Qodo Agentic Toolbox skills for understanding your codebase, reviewing changes, and resolving code review findings
The Qodo Agentic Toolbox brings Qodo's code understanding, coding standards, and review capabilities into your existing coding agent.
